messages:
elaine_p: Heads-up — vendors dropped overlapping press windows for H200 / MI300 / Gaudi. Can partnerships + ops propose a staggered announce plan and a short fallback routing policy for marketplace SKUs? Need short decision today.

raj_k: do you have the raw overlap dates?

elaine_p: rough vendor dates I pulled from vendor threads: H200 embargo 2025-08-12..08-14, MI300 2025-08-13..08-15, Gaudi 2025-08-12..08-13.

marina_pm: yikes that is tight for press and SI enablement. prefer Gaudi earlier or smaller window.

tara_ops: lab capacity + oncall are limited 08-12..08-14 — we already have a kernel upload scheduled. risk of delayed images.

sam_oncall: +1. If Gaudi slips, propose: fallback SKU = B200-compat for first week post-announce to avoid customer disrupt.

raj_k: technical note: Gaudi driver v2.3 has a quant perf quirk on long-seq inference. patch ready but needs one CI cycle (≈48h) and signoff from SI.

elaine_p: cool. proposal for decision: stagger by region to reduce press collision and ops pressure — APAC Gaudi 2025-08-12, NA H200 2025-08-13, EU MI300 2025-08-14. Shift embargo start times by 24h. Ops/Eng: can you validate feasibility?

tara_ops: ops/labs: we can produce Gaudi APAC builds by 2025-08-11 if SI signs off today. If SI can't, fallback plan: temporarily disable Gaudi autoshard in marketplace for 72h and surface "limited availability" note.

marina_pm: marketing ask: @sam_oncall @raj_k — please fill the announce checklist now (tags, pricing, SKU names, compatibility matrix), we need copy for press.

sam_oncall: copying short checklist here:
- release notes
- marketplace SKU tag
- compatibility matrix
- canary images with metrics
- oncall runbook + escalation contact

raj_k: adding kernel build tag: `gaudi-driver-v2.3-hotfix-1`. Will push binary to staging once CI passes.

elaine_p: if SI can't ship images in time, we publish a brief note: "Limited Gaudi availability at launch; H200/MI300 fully supported." Keep comms simple.

announce-bot: Calendar event created: "Vendor Launch Stagger - Aug 2025" 2025-08-12 09:00 UTC — attendees: partnerships, ops, eng, pm

marina_pm: thx — one more ask: who owns the fallback policy doc? want a 1-page runbook by EOD tomorrow.

raj_k: i'll draft the fallback runbook. will paste a concise snippet here for ops review (approx 10-12 bullet lines).

tara_ops: ops will validate runbook and confirm lab/time windows. Also will call out kernel promotion steps and rollback play (we need `rollback-image-id` and `canary-route` flags).

elaine_p: perfect. next sync in #partnerships tomorrow 10:30 PT to lock windows. :thumbsup:

sam_oncall: noted. adding PRD ownership: Marina will own comms, Raj owns kernel & fallback doc, Tara owns ops validation, Elaine owns vendor comms.

elaine_p: thanks all — i'll collect decisions after the sync and nudge vendors.
